div.span: Dyno measures, explains and tunes one PC for its owner. It reads the operating system through ports, asks the user before it changes anything, and exchanges data with Debrief and Pitwall only when the user clicks (ADR 0001, 0006).

div.span: Watches the machine, asks “why is it slow?”, tames apps, cleans up. Approves every change.
